body:
deploy-bot: initiated staged rollout v2.14 -> 5% to api-service
maria: noticed error spike on /v1/generate at ~1813456795; 5xx rate 0.3% -> 2.6% in 5m
kevin: @maria can you paste example req ids?
maria: samples: `req_7b9f`, `req_7c01`
kevin: checking logs: replica-3 shows `kvcache OOM` and longer tail latency for >=512 token requests
arjun: any scheduled load tests or traffic changes?
maria: none. small bump from mobile but not matching this spike
lia: recommendation: pause canary and pin traffic back to v2.13 until we confirm root cause
maria: +1 pause
deploy-bot: pausing rollout: canary v2.14 halted at 5% by user maria
kevin: rolling traffic back to v2.13 for api route, running smoke tests
kevin: command:
```
rbctl rollout set --service api --from v2.14 --to v2.13 --percent 100 --reason "canary pause - kvcache OOM"
```
deploy-bot: traffic now switching to v2.13; estimated completion 18s
maria: monitoring — 5xxs down to 0.4% after rollback, holding
lia: also request a staging config parity check for kv cache sizes and eviction policy
arjun: can we grab heap/alloc profiles from replica-3 before any reboot? @kevin
kevin: will pull heap + logs and upload to /shared/debug; if needed we'll reboot after captures
release-manager: scheduling a quick retro and considering a v2.14 hotfix; request blocking further api deploys in change window until 10:00 PST tomorrow
lia: ack, will block api deploys in change window
deploy-bot: note recorded: incident candidate - tags: canary-hold,kvcache,rollback
oncall: ack — will watch alerts and notify if recurrence
maria: thanks all. ping #eng-oncall and @kevin if you see new spikes
kevin: next steps: upload artifacts, draft postmortem, add guardrail preventing >512 token requests from hitting unguarded kvcache
